Major Revision is defined as any one of the following: 1) A change in land use type(s) for 25% or more of the existing Sketch Plan area; 2) 25% or greater increase in projected population or employment; 3) 25% or greater addition or area to the original Sketch Plan; 4) 10% or greater decrease in total park and/or open space area. Minor Revision is any revision that does not meet the thresholds of a major revision. All increases must be elevated to PC and BoCC.
